topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: They said it was just a transfer, but it feels like the walls of my cubicle are closing in, whispering of change and uncertainty. I keep hoping, every morning, that today might be the day I wake up and find everything as it was. The walk to the new department is a labyrinth now, each corner a new kind of silence. I greet the faces around me, trying to weave myself into the fabric of this new space, but the threads keep slipping through my fingers. I tell myself it’s just a matter of time, that I’ll belong here, but the clock ticks louder with each passing second, and I can’t seem to find the right place in its rhythm.
